status: prepared for freeze; TEST v2 not started

design.question: On an independent private sample of information needs drawn from DEV's task taxonomy, does the frozen E improve over the frozen E5 at top-10 retrieval?

population.rule: DEV's answerable profiles (answerability complete or partial), one slot each in DEV's need order; the none profiles never enter TEST v2
population.copies: universe // slots for every slot, one more for the universe % slots slots first in a draw ('extra-copy')

priority.rule: candidate <slot>-<copy>, ordered by the hex SHA-256 of '<seed>:<salt hex>:priority:<candidate id>'; the rank fixes the need id (N401 for the first); independent of completion order, of any system's output and of judging

anchors.unit: the article (legal unit): in an area of the protocol's section 10, outside the PSD2 articles amended after the snapshot, with at least one provision of its own text owned by a chunk; never a raw chunk or node frequency
anchors.rule: per act of the profile (a cross-act profile gets one anchor per act), in priority order: the act's eligible articles in an order drawn once ('article'), the i-th demand taking article i, wrapping only when all are drawn (uniform, without replacement while capacity permits, then a deterministic counted reuse); the provision a draw over the article's eligible nodes ('provision'), shifted by its earlier uses

design.reserve: the earliest candidates in priority order that survive deduplication and become evaluable form the primary sample; the unused tail is the single reserve; no regeneration, no second reserve; a bank exhausted before N freezes the N achieved. A candidate leaves only for an outcome-independent reason: a duplicate, an unusable or anchor-copying generation, an exhausted technical retry, mechanical non-evaluability

hops.A_concept: v2_concept_author (concept_author.v2): the profile and its anchors with their article's title and ancestors; nothing of DEV, the fixtures, the exclusions, other candidates, systems, rankings, qrels or metrics
hops.B_need: statement_writer (statement_writer.v1): the concept and its facts only, never an anchor, an identifier or a location
hops.C_queries: query_writer (query_variants.v1): the statement only; three formulations (EN formal, EN natural, ES natural)

generation.concept_checks: the concept_author.v1 shape; no legal reference (benchmark._LEGAL_REFERENCE); no legal wording or 8-word run of DEV or the fixtures (holdout_packets.author_leaks); no run of 8 words of its anchor's article
generation.leakage_filter: a run of 8 consecutive words of an anchor's article in the statement or a query drops the candidate (near-copying); shorter runs and shared vocabulary are measured and reported, never a filter
generation.parallel: every hop in parallel over the bank; completion order decides nothing

deduplication.method: one global stage after the whole bank is generated, in priority order

prefilter.mandatory: every reference or earlier bank candidate with the same normalized statement or a content-word Jaccard >= 0.5; every earlier bank candidate sharing an anchor article
prefilter.bounded: the 6 most similar references and 6 most similar earlier candidates by BGE-M3 cosine, the 3 most similar of either by Jaccard

deduplication.decision: overlap_gate.v2 under opaque ids; a candidate is kept only if every packet finds it independent; only kept earlier candidates are shown; priority wins

references.statement: the 99 historical statements stay hidden references because they are part of D-066's documented history, keeping them avoids reinterpreting it, and corpus anchoring makes the cost low; their exclusion is NOT claimed to be strictly necessary for statistical validity. Authors never see them. No recursive blacklist: only designated DEVELOPMENT topic-generation material may become a development reference; technical failures never do

pooling.anchor: the chunk that owns each anchor, whether or not any retriever returns it
pooling.union: over the need's three formulations, each chunk once
pooling.judged: every node a pooled chunk owns with its own text, outside the excluded PSD2 articles; its ancestors are shown as context
pooling.provenance: kept internally (contributor, formulation, rank); never shown to a judge
pooling.decisive_set: the union over the formulations of E top-10 minus E5 top-10, plus E5 top-10 minus E top-10
pooling.pool_only: BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B contribute to the pool, never to a confirmatory comparison
pooling.excluded: no one-hop expansion, no sixth retriever

judging.B1: v2_pool_judge_1 (judge_b_pool.v3): every judged node of the pool, explicit 0s kept, opaque ids, exact coverage; nodes grouped by chunk in document order, the groups in an order drawn per need and stage (seed 20261028)
judging.B2: v2_pool_judge_2, independent and blind: every node B1 graded >= 1 or found ambiguous, and every node of the decisive set, whatever B1 said
judging.C: judge_c (judge_c.v2) on exactly the nodes where B1 and B2 differ in grade or ambiguity
judging.final: the agreed label or C's; a final ambiguity stays in the qrels and never deletes the need; an ambiguous or unresolved node counts as unjudged (D-019)
judging.retired: judge D, the Qwen diagnostic, adjudication_uncertain and final_qrels_unambiguous rejections
judging.waves: in priority order, each as large as the evaluable needs still missing

after_qrels.evaluability: mechanical: at least one final non-ambiguous node of grade >= 2
after_qrels.qrel_freeze: the first N_TARGET evaluable needs in priority order; fewer if the bank is exhausted
after_qrels.answerability: descriptive, after the qrels (answerability.v1): a `none` against grade >= 2 evidence is a contradiction recorded and routed to a second blind judgment (v2_answerability_2), and to judge C where the two differ; exhausted: unknown. It never filters the sample
after_qrels.metadata: metadata_adjudicator on the final grades >= 1; exhausted or unknown answerability: unknown. It never removes a need

completeness.chains: per act, every candidate whose profile's first act it is, in an order drawn with the bank ('completeness'); the stratum's needs are the first of its chain in the primary sample
completeness.screen: v2_screen (completeness_screen.v1): every chunk of the layer outside the need's pool that owns a node to judge, one blind judge, high recall, about screen_max_passages per batch
completeness.follow_up: the flagged chunks' nodes through B1, B2 and C; only a final non-ambiguous grade >= 2 counts as a verified residual relevant chunk
completeness.use: sensitivity SA2 only: it never modifies the primary qrels, restarts or invalidates TEST

evaluation.relevance: Recall@10 at grade >= 2; nDCG@10 the grades as linear gains (ingest/ir_metrics.py)
evaluation.unit: the information need: the mean of its three formulations first

bootstrap.interval: percentile, sorted means at int(0.025 * reps) and int(0.975 * reps) - 1

evaluation.verdicts: holds if the lower end > 0, reverses if the upper end < 0, inconclusive otherwise; S4's table of claims

evaluator.projection: ingest/evaluation.py project: a chunk's grade is the highest final grade it owns; an ambiguous or unresolved label is unjudged (D-019)

evaluation.incomplete_systems: a system that fails technically runs again, unchanged, once; then it is not completed; if E or E5 is not completed the primary comparison is not made
sensitivity: SA1 ambiguity: final ambiguous labels at their grade
SA2 augmented qrels on the 15 completeness needs
SA3 fixed-scale G@10: DCG@10 linear / DCG@10 of ten grade-3 chunks
SA4 residual relevance: unjudged top-10 bounds; residual relevance outside the pool in fixed scenarios (1 chunk of grade 2, 3 chunks of grade 3 per need)
SA5 nDCG gains: grade 1 as 0; exponential 2^g - 1
SA6 paired t interval and paired sign-flip permutation test
SA7 optional human audit, never corrective
pool_diagnostics: relevant chunks contributed uniquely by each pool system
evaluable needs whose only grade >= 2 evidence one compared system alone brought

human_audit.rule: optional, blind, non-blocking, non-corrective: reported through SA7; TEST 1.0.0 is never replaced

execution.retry: the same packet in a new isolated context; a valid answer is never run again; after the last execution the job is exhausted, recorded once, and its candidate or need moves on by the frozen priority
execution.provider_capacity: a call the provider refuses for its capacity (the CLI's final result or stderr naming a usage limit, rate_limit_error or overloaded_error) never counts toward the limit: a wait of 300 s doubling to an hour, once per episode, and a pause after 21600 s without a response; every other failure counts
execution.isolation: every response audited by the role's contract (holdout_roles audit_role_run); a single forbidden-content finding that disappears once metadata values are neutralized is retried; any other finding is an integrity stop
execution.not_stops: new relevance, low pool recall, ambiguity, disagreement, hard needs, N < 200 after the bank, any result of E or E5, a small effect, an interval across 0
operational_knobs: workers (concurrent model calls; a resume may lower it)
the batch ceilings, frozen here: pool_max_nodes, pool_max_tokens, screen_max_passages, screen_max_tokens
the local resource queue: one local model at a time
execution.local_queue: the local models (E5, BGE-M3, Qwen3-Embedding, BM25, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-Reranker) one at a time, never beside another heavy model

E5.scoring: dot product of the normalized mean-pooled vectors (its similarity)
E5.ranking: score descending, then chunk id ascending (ingest/retrieval.py rank_by_scores)
E5.depth: every chunk of the layer, at least ingest/evaluation.MIN_RUN_DEPTH

BM25.corpus_unit: the chunk_text of every chunk of the layer
BM25.ranking: score descending, then chunk id ascending (ingest/retrieval.py rank_by_scores)

E.rule: D's rule on each requirement's first 50 E5 chunks reordered by the reranker
E.d_rule: E5's first 6; places 7 to 10 to corroborated E5 ranks 7 to 10, then each requirement's best chunk outside E5's top 10 in turns, then the rest of E5's 7 to 10; the 10 in E5's order (K = 5)

decomposer.unreadable: fewer than 2 readable requirements keep E5's ranking

config.name: qwen3-reranker-0.6b
config.prefix:
<|im_start|>system
Judge whether the Document meets the requirements based on the Query and the Instruct provided. Note that the answer can only be "yes" or "no".<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user

reranker.instruction: Given a question about EU financial regulation, retrieve the passages of the law that answer it
reranker.order: descending score; equal scores keep E5's order

assembler.after_the_ten: the rest of E5's ranking, in E5's order

aborted_runs.reason: The frozen Qwen diagnostic recovery policy assumed that a repeated technical execution could produce a different semantic output. In the real S3 run Qwen3-8B was running greedy deterministic decoding, so a structurally malformed but successfully generated response was likely reproducible. Retrying the identical semantic execution was therefore not a meaningful recovery strategy.
aborted_runs.change: the diagnostic's failure semantics only (holdout_checks.py diagnostic_admissible); sampling, grid, order, prompts, judges and systems unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: The omission audit's hard stop: a second blind search found evidence judge A had missed, adjudicated grade >= 1, so that the frozen rule called for the evidence search to be corrected for every need alike. The review that followed also found control-flow defects (outputs admitted without their full contract, a second searcher's declared problem with no transition, audits bound to the wrong attempt, unbounded processes, a controller that could act on a stale failure). The run is kept whole as a protocol-development run, and TEST restarts prospectively under one final procedure for every need, rather than being repaired.
aborted_runs.change: evidence discovery: two blind searches for every need, their union adjudicated once, and the omission audit as a third blind search (config/holdout/evidence-discovery.md); complete admission of every output; bounded processes with verified cleanup; the diagnostic's token preflight; every reachable failure classified (config/holdout/failure-paths.md); the unattended controller in the repository. Sampling, grid, order, omission cells, templates, judges, thresholds, systems and the S4 metrics unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: Three independent executions of the metadata adjudicator gave a well-formed answer violating the same frozen semantic rule of its stage, so that technical retries could not repair it and the stage was left pending_technical_unresolved. The transition for that class was defined prospectively, and TEST restarts under it.
aborted_runs.change: a semantic admissibility failure, the same frozen invariant violated in the three executions of search A, search B or the metadata adjudicator, rejects the attempt (semantic_inadmissible); contract failures and search C keep their technical exhaustion. Everything else unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: Three executions of judge C answered the item they were given for another legal node, a failure of the role's contract, so that the stage was left pending_technical_unresolved. A candidate's identity was carried by its act and path, which the model wrote back itself, rather than by an id the orchestrator owns.
aborted_runs.change: the identity of what a judge grades: every candidate of judges B, C and D and of the diagnostic is given under an opaque item id, answered by that exact id and mapped to its node by the orchestrator alone (judge_b.v2, judge_c.v2, judge_d.v2); a missing, unknown, repeated or other id stays a technical contract failure. Rubrics, thresholds, retries and every methodological rule unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: The omission audit's hard stop: the audit search listed a node outside the union of searches A and B, adjudicated grade >= 1. A structural review, counts only, found that most omissions were nodes the missing search had read in full and not listed: coverage depended on each search's discretionary, softly capped listing
aborted_runs.change: three fixed blind searches for every need; a mechanical exposure pool (every node a search received in full, listed or not, is judged: judge B's pool variant, a second blind judgment for a grade >= 1 or an ambiguity, judge C on a difference); the audit search's coverage is its own exposure; judge D and the diagnostic on the listed nodes and the pool's contested or relevant ones; no number of candidates in the searches' template (judge_a.v3); the controller's outer deadline 72 hours. The rubrics, the omission threshold >= 1, the retries and every other rule unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: The omission audit's hard stop, a valid application of the frozen rule: the audit search reached three nodes outside the exposure pool, each adjudicated grade 1. A read-only structural review found no controller or bookkeeping defect, but a gap in the exposure policy: one node only a search snippet had named, which no search opened, and two article lead-ins shown to the judges as the context of their children, never as candidates. The run is development evidence only: none of its needs, READY records, qrels or other outputs enters a later TEST
aborted_runs.change: exposure v2, rule A, designed after this run's stop and declared as such: the pool also takes every node a search page named, followed up in full, and every ancestor with its own text of a node reached, as a candidate of its own; no article is expanded; the audit search is measured by the same rules. A wider rule that also took every node of an article a search listed was implemented and evaluated before any freeze and not adopted. The development need exclusions in the overlap gate (overlap_gate.v2); D-061's review metrics defined operationally; Gate 1 from a sealed certification. Three normal searches, the omission threshold >= 1, the rubrics, the judges and every other rule unchanged

aborted_runs.reason: The frozen minimum feasibility rule: the first five evaluable cells exhausted their attempts, so at most 49 of the required 50 evaluable needs stayed reachable. 240 events, 0 READY, no retrieval and no E-vs-E5 result. An external methodological review followed, before any TEST retrieval existed
aborted_runs.change: TEST v2 (D-067): a new prospective protocol, not a repair of run 7
